A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  draws AS (
    SELECT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host,
           count() AS attempts,
           countIf(attributes_string['loom.dispatch.admission_result'] = 'refused'
                   AND attributes_string['loom.dispatch.reason'] IN
                       ('pool_exhausted', 'no_token_pool', 'token_selection_failed',
                        'claimed', 'claim_lost')) AS passes
    FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
    WHERE name = 'loom.dispatch.step'
      AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}))
      AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}))
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       host,
       toFloat64(passes) / attempts AS value
FROM draws
WHERE host != ''
  AND attempts >= 10
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: On host {{$labels.host}}, {{$value}} of the loom.dispatch.step attempts in 30 min (at least 10) were refused by the pool gate (pool_exhausted, no_token_pool, token_selection_failed) or the claim (claimed, claim_lost). Above 0.8 the redraw budget (8 per slot, 32 per tick) is spent on items that cannot run: an exhausted role pool the draw does not yet exclude, or peers contending for the same items. Break the attempts down by loom.dispatch.reason and loom.role. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
